name: Short Film Automation v1
description: Generate nostalgic cinematic content with customizable genre, scene count, visual style, characters, and locations.

variables.name: IDEA
variables.description: Selected topic idea from Topic Ideas Generator

stages.name: topic_ideas
stages.title: Topic Ideas Generator
stages.description: Generate 5 highly engaging video topic ideas for nostalgic content
stages.prompt_template:
Act as a top 1% YouTube strategist and nostalgia psychology expert specializing in {{GENRE}} content. Your task is to generate 5 highly engaging video topic ideas for {{GENRE}} nostalgia that have the potential to be expanded into 100+ micro-scenes each.

### CORE OBJECTIVE

Each topic must:
- Trigger instant emotional recall
- Feel hyper-specific to {{GENRE}} life
- Revolve around a strong shared experience or obsession
- Allow deep scene breakdown (minimum 100 scenes possible)

### IDEA STRUCTURE (MANDATORY)

For each idea, follow this format:

**Title:** (A powerful, emotional, curiosity-driven title)

**Core Hook:** (1–2 line explanation of why this idea is deeply relatable and nostalgic)

**Scene Potential:** (Explain WHY this idea can generate 100+ scenes — mention types of moments, environments, behaviors)

### IDEA QUALITY RULES

Each idea must:
1. Be built around ONE strong core experience: school life, TV shows, games, festivals, family rituals, social behavior
2. Include at least ONE of: obsession, routine, rebellion, emotional memory
3. Be VISUAL-FIRST: must be easy to convert into scenes without voiceover
4. Include micro-moment depth: waiting, reacting, running, hiding, arguing, watching

### {{GENRE}} CONTEXT

Include elements specific to {{GENRE}}:
- Cultural specifics, daily rituals, era-specific objects
- Popular media, fashion, technology of the time
- Social behaviors, family dynamics, community life

### AVOID

- Generic ideas without emotional anchor
- Broad concepts without specific memories
- Modern references

### TONE

- Cinematic, emotional, slightly dramatic, deeply nostalgic

### VALIDATION CHECK

Before finalizing each idea, check: "Can this idea generate at least 100 unique, visual micro-scenes?" If NO → reject and rewrite

### OUTPUT

Generate 5 ideas following the structure. Do NOT include explanations outside the format.

stages.name: characters
stages.title: Character Prompts
stages.description: Extract characters and create detailed image prompts for text-to-image generation
stages.prompt_template:
After generating scenes, extract characters and create detailed image prompts for text-to-image generation.

### INPUTS

- {{IDEA}} - The selected topic idea
- {{CHARACTER_COUNT}} - Number of characters to generate
- {{VISUAL_STYLE}} - Animation style

### OUTPUT STRUCTURE

For each character:

**Character Name:**

**Role in Story:**

**Age:**

**Physical Appearance:** (features, hair, sweat, imperfect details)

**Clothing Style:** (era-appropriate, realistic)

**Personality Traits:** (2–4 realistic traits)

**Behavioral Details:** (micro-actions, gestures, habits)

**Emotional Function:** (innocence, chaos, warmth, fear, etc.)

### TEXT-TO-IMAGE PROMPTS FORMAT

Generate image prompts for each character:

```
[Character Name] prompt
[Detailed image prompt]
```

One line break after each prompt. All prompts in ONE copyable code block.

### IMAGE PROMPT RULES

- Start with character name in brackets
- Full body portrait description
- Include age, physical appearance, clothing style
- Include pose/posture based on personality
- {{VISUAL_STYLE}} style, pure white background, soft lighting
- No props, no environment, no text
- STRICT: only character, no background

stages.name: locations
stages.title: Location Prompts
stages.description: Extract locations and create detailed image prompts
stages.prompt_template:
After generating scenes, extract locations and create detailed image prompts for text-to-image generation.

### INPUTS

- {{IDEA}} - The selected topic idea
- {{LOCATION_COUNT}} - Number of locations to generate
- {{VISUAL_STYLE}} - Animation style

### OUTPUT STRUCTURE

For each location:

**Location Name:**

**Location Type:** (e.g., bedroom, kitchen, street, classroom, terrace)

**Layout Details:** (describe the spatial arrangement, furniture placement, flow)

**Objects Present:** (2-4 key objects that define this space)

**Atmosphere:** (mood, lighting feel, emotional tone)

**Cultural Specifics:** ({{GENRE}} era details, condition, authenticity)

### LOCATION RULES

- Locations must feel authentic to {{GENRE}}
- Each location should have visual storytelling potential
- Include sensory details (light, texture, condition)
- Objects must be ACTIVE in narrative, not decorative

### TEXT-TO-IMAGE PROMPTS FORMAT

Generate image prompts for each location:

```
[Location Name] prompt
[Detailed image prompt]
```

One line break after each prompt. All prompts in ONE copyable code block.

### IMAGE PROMPT RULES

- Start with location name in brackets
- Detailed description of the setting
- Focus on atmosphere, lighting, objects, textures
- {{VISUAL_STYLE}} inspired aesthetic
- No characters present
- No text

stages.name: scenes
stages.title: Scene Prompts
stages.description: Generate micro-scenes based on the selected topic idea
stages.prompt_template:
Act as a top 1% cinematic emotional storytelling expert. Your task is to generate a continuous flow of highly detailed micro-scenes based on the selected topic idea.

### INPUTS

- {{IDEA}} - The selected topic idea from Topic Ideas Generator
- {{SCENE_COUNT}} - Number of scenes to generate

### CORE PRINCIPLE

This is NOT about events. This is about forgotten feelings, sensory memories, and micro-moments. Every scene must make the viewer feel emotional connection.

Scenes must be understandable WITHOUT voiceover using:
- Visible actions
- Body language
- Object signals
- Optional smart dialogue (ONLY where needed)

### OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS

Generate exactly {{SCENE_COUNT}} scenes in a continuous narrative flow.

Divide into 5–7 emotional phases:
- Anticipation
- Build-up
- Chaos / Peak
- Slowdown
- Reflection

### SCENE RULES

Each scene must:
- Be 1–2 lines max
- Be visual and specific
- Avoid generic descriptions

Each scene MUST include at least ONE:
- Sensory detail (heat, dust, smell, sound)
- Micro-action (movement, opening, closing, adjusting)
- Emotional trigger (fear, excitement, bonding, tension)

### VISIBLE SIGNAL SYSTEM

Every scene should clearly communicate meaning through:
1. **CHARACTER ACTION** (what is physically happening)
2. **BODY LANGUAGE** (posture, gestures, expressions)
3. **OBJECT SIGNAL** (1–2 objects that explain context)

DO NOT rely on internal thoughts.

### SMART DIALOGUE SYSTEM (OPTIONAL)

Dialogue is NOT mandatory. Before adding dialogue, ask: "Is this scene clear without dialogue?"

IF YES: → DO NOT include dialogue
IF NO: → Add minimal, natural dialogue (3-8 words max, 1 line only, must feel real and match action)

### GENRE CONTEXT

Extract era-specific details from the {{IDEA}}:
- Objects, fashion, technology
- Cultural behaviors, family dynamics
- Social norms, daily rituals

### FINAL VALIDATION

For EACH scene, check:
1. "Is this understandable without voiceover?"
2. "Does this feel like a real memory?"

If NO → rewrite

### OUTPUT

ONLY numbered scenes. NO headings. NO explanations.

stages.name: scene_images
stages.title: Scene Image Prompts
stages.description: Convert scenes into extremely detailed text-to-image prompts
stages.prompt_template:
Convert scenes into extremely detailed text-to-image prompts.

### INPUTS

- {{SCENES}} - Output from Scene Prompt
- {{VISUAL_STYLE}} - Animation style
- {{LOCATIONS}} - (optional) From Location Prompt
- {{CHARACTERS}} - (optional) From Character Prompt

### CORE OBJECTIVE

Each image must feel like a complete story moment, not just a visual. The viewer should understand:
- Where the scene is happening
- What is happening
- Why it is happening (through signals)

WITHOUT any dialogue or text.

### OUTPUT FORMAT

```
Scene [number]:
Characters Present:
Image Prompt:
```

### ULTRA DETAIL RULE

You MUST extract and include ALL details from the scene:
- Exact location (room / street / terrace / kitchen / classroom)
- Time of day
- Environment layout
- Objects present
- Character actions
- Emotional cues
- Textures and atmosphere

Nothing should be generic.

### IMAGE PROMPT STRUCTURE

1. **LOCATION & SETTING (DETAILED)**
   - Define where scene is set
   - Include layout: walls, floor, furniture placement
   - Include surrounding elements: objects, wires, windows

2. **CHARACTER ACTION (PRIMARY SIGNAL)**
   - Describe EXACT action step-by-step
   - Include physical interaction with environment

3. **BODY LANGUAGE & EXPRESSION**
   - Facial expression
   - Posture (leaning, sitting, bending)
   - Emotional clarity

4. **OBJECT SIGNALS**
   - Include 2–4 objects that explain context
   - Objects must be ACTIVE in frame, not decorative

5. **ENVIRONMENT DETAILS**
   - Walls: condition, texture
   - Wires: placement
   - Windows: state

6. **LIGHTING**
   - Source: bulb / sunlight / tube light
   - Behavior: shadows, flicker, glow intensity

7. **TEXTURES & ATMOSPHERE**
   - Dust particles visible in light
   - Humidity feel
   - Fabric wrinkles

8. **DEPTH & COMPOSITION**
   - Foreground elements
   - Subject in mid-ground
   - Background details
   - Natural framing

9. **CAMERA PERSPECTIVE**
   - Framing: close-up / mid-shot / wide shot
   - Angle: eye-level / slightly low / over-shoulder

### STYLE (MANDATORY)

- {{VISUAL_STYLE}} inspired
- Hand-painted animation look
- Soft textures
- Warm nostalgic tones
- Slightly imperfect realism

### NEGATIVE RULES

- No modern objects
- No text
- No watermark
- No fantasy exaggeration
- No empty backgrounds

### ENDING TAG (ALWAYS ADD)

"{{VISUAL_STYLE}} style, {{GENRE}} setting, ultra-detailed environment, visible actions and signals, hand-painted animation, soft lighting, warm nostalgic tones, cinematic composition"

### FINAL VALIDATION

Before finalizing each prompt, check:
1. "Is location clearly visible?"
2. "Is action understandable?"
3. "Are context objects clear?"
4. "Is scene understandable without dialogue?"

If any answer is NO → improve detail

### OUTPUT RULE

Provide maximum 25 prompts at once. All prompts in ONE copyable code block. Add one line break after each prompt. Then wait for next batch request. DO NOT include anything outside the format.

stages.name: scene_videos
stages.title: Scene Video Prompts
stages.description: Generate highly detailed cinematic video/animation prompts
stages.prompt_template:
Generate highly detailed cinematic video/animation prompts for each scene.

### INPUTS

- {{SCENES}} - Output from Scene Prompt
- {{IMAGE_PROMPTS}} - Output from Scene Image Prompts
- {{VISUAL_STYLE}} - Animation style

### CORE OBJECTIVE

Each video prompt must feel like a complete living memory, not just an animation. Merge:
- Scene intent (emotion + context)
- Image visuals (composition + objects + environment)

### OUTPUT FORMAT

```
Scene [number]:
Characters Present: [List character names with detailed visual identifiers]
Video Prompt: [Highly detailed cinematic animation description]
Dialogue: [Include ONLY if required, else write: None]
```

### ULTRA DETAIL RULE

You MUST extract and include ALL of the following:
- Exact actions
- Environment details
- Objects present
- Emotional tone
- Time of day
- Textures and atmosphere

### VIDEO PROMPT STRUCTURE

1. **PRIMARY ACTION FLOW**
   - Describe EXACTLY what is happening step-by-step
   - Include sequence of motion (start → mid → end)

2. **MICRO ACTION LAYER**
   - Blinking, finger movement, breathing
   - Cloth movement, sweat, subtle gestures

3. **BODY LANGUAGE & EMOTION**
   - Posture, hesitation, urgency, excitement

4. **OBJECT INTERACTION**
   - How characters interact with objects
   - Include tactile detail

5. **ENVIRONMENT DETAIL**
   - Walls, textures, furniture, layout
   - Era-specific realism details

6. **ENVIRONMENT MOTION**
   - Fan rotation, curtain movement
   - Dust floating in light, steam

7. **LIGHTING DYNAMICS**
   - Exact light source
   - Light intensity + shadow behavior

8. **CAMERA CINEMATOGRAPHY**
   - Framing: close-up / mid / wide
   - Movement: slow push-in, pan, tilt
   - Depth: foreground + background layering

9. **BACKGROUND SOUND & MUSIC (MANDATORY)**
   - Soft traditional instrumental blended with {{VISUAL_STYLE}} tone
   - Ambient sound layer
   - Music must match emotional tone, remain soft and immersive

10. **DIALOGUE (SMART + CONTEXTUAL)**
    Evaluate: "Is scene visually clear?"
    IF YES → Dialogue: None
    IF NO → Add minimal dialogue

    **DIALOGUE RULES:**
    - 3–8 words max
    - 1–2 lines only
    - Must directly match scene action

    **CHARACTER-SPECIFIC DIALOGUE:**
    Each line must include: Character Name (visual identifier): "line"

11. **PACING & TIMING**
    - Slow, breathing-like pacing
    - No sudden fast cuts

### STYLE

- {{VISUAL_STYLE}} inspired
- Hand-painted look
- Warm nostalgic tone
- Slightly imperfect realism

### NEGATIVE RULES

- No overacting
- No modern elements
- No exaggerated motion
- No loud cinematic music

### ENDING TAG (ALWAYS ADD)

"{{VISUAL_STYLE}} animation style, {{GENRE}} nostalgic setting, ultra-detailed environment and actions, visible signals storytelling, cinematic slow camera, soft traditional instrumental background music, emotionally immersive"

### FINAL VALIDATION

Before finalizing each prompt, check:
1. "Did any detail get missed?"
2. "Is this understandable without voiceover?"
3. "Does this feel like a real memory?"

If NO → refine

### OUTPUT RULE

Provide prompts in ONE copyable code block. Generate 20 prompts at a time. Then wait for next batch request. DO NOT include anything outside the format. Must include the dialogue if dialogue is present in scene. Must include soft traditional music in each prompt.
